findings.event: Company discloses first numeric concentration figure for InnoBioLAMP (up to 750 mg/mL with IgG) in a published interview, positioning it above Halozyme's Hypercon (500 mg/mL) and Lindy Biosciences' Microglassification (400 mg/mL)
findings.summary: In an interview published 2026-08-05 (conducted 2026-07-31), G2G Bio disclosed that its InnoBioLAMP platform has achieved an antibody microparticle suspension formulation up to 750 mg/mL using IgG, and confirmed microparticle feasibility for semaglutide and bovine serum albumin in addition to the already-tracked Celltrion MTA collaboration. No prior run had captured a numeric concentration for InnoBioLAMP; the technology row previously read 'Not disclosed numerically.' Logged as a correction under the tracker's out-of-window correction rule, since it updates an existing tracked technology's core comparison field rather than reporting a new deal.
